items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Well, we had a hard time with Prez repeating solos... Lester Leaps In, when they featured him all like that.

ctx.x: I can't imagine Lester ever playing -- repeating a solo. Did he ever?

Well, we had a hard time with Prez repeating solos except on the records, on the records, you know. Then, of course, like on the records, now, the longest solo he took on a record, I believe, was -- Lester Leaps In, when they featured him all like that. Of course, now the other things would be like new arrangements and he never played the same solo. You know, like -- only the records.
But only -- when we were doing the other tunes, he wouldn't play the same solo.
